hooks.name: Security Advisory After File Write
hooks.description: Advisory prompt to verify zero-knowledge privacy compliance after file modifications

action.prompt: After writing code, verify: 1) No plaintext feedback content is logged or stored server-side. 2) No localStorage usage — only sessionStorage. 3) No identity-revealing metadata persisted. 4) Encryption uses AES-256-GCM + RSA-OAEP standards only.
